entries.title: I Corinthians 13:1
segments: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I have become [as] sounding brass or a tinkling cymbal.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:2
segments: And though I have prophecies, and understand all mysteries and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so as to move mountains, and do not have charity, I am nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:3
segments: And though I give out all my goods [to feed the poor], and though I deliver my body to be burned, and have not charity, I am profited nothing.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:4
segments: Charity has patience, is kind; charity is not envious, is not vain, is not puffed up;

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:5
segments: does not behave indecently, does not seek her own, is not easily provoked, thinks no evil.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:6
segments: Charity does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices in the truth,

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:7
segments: quietly covers all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:8
segments: Charity never fails. But if [there are] prophecies, they will be abolished; if tongues, they shall cease; if knowledge, it will be abolished.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:9
segments: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:10
segments: But when the perfect thing comes, then that which is in part will be caused to cease.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:11
segments: When I was an infant, I spoke as an infant, I thought as an infant, I reasoned as an infant. But when I became a man, I did away with the things of an infant.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:12
segments: For now we see in a mirror dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I shall fully know even as I also am fully known.

entries.title: I Corinthians 13:13
segments: And now faith, hope, charity, these three remain; but the greatest of these [is] charity.
